name: APIVerveBoggleBoardGenerator
summary: Boggle Board Generator creates random Boggle game boards with authentic dice configurations, HTML rendering, and downloadable PNG images.
description:
Boggle Board Generator creates random Boggle game boards with authentic dice configurations, HTML rendering, and downloadable PNG images.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Boggle Board Generator from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
